verdict.rationale: Linear's own GitHub integration says it can "sync issues", and the changelog refers to "GitHub-synced" issues, so first-party issue sync with the repository's tracker exists. The evidence never states the sync is bi-directional or which fields and changes propagate each way, so only part of the story is proven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of two-way sync (changes in either system reflected in the other), details of which fields and statuses sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
